statement: HBM4 manufacturing is reported to demand roughly triple the wafer capacity of traditional DRAM.
why: Tripling wafer consumption per bit means the HBM ramp needed for AI accelerators structurally reduces total memory output available to everyone else.

impact.mechanism: Converting DRAM lines to HBM4 removes roughly two conventional DRAM bits for every HBM bit added, tightening overall memory supply that GPU systems depend on.

evidence.excerpt: notes 'HBM4 manufacturing demands approximately triple the wafer capacity compared to traditional DRAM.'

confidence.basis: Approximate ratio described in a single secondary outlet without a named producer disclosure.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend falling -> falling); sources: IDC (idc.com), Parameter.io
